title: fix(core): chart compare-to shifts {current_iso_week} to the compared week
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbD5gxSWeWGswbZYVzNvtqNM)_
Fixes #35395

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 仪表盘作者在图表筛选里用「本 ISO 周」并开启环比时,对比曲线从「同一周」改为「上一周」(同比则为去年同一天所在周),趋势标签显示「较上周」。
- 修复图表环比/同比功能里的一处遗漏,替用周主数据做报表的作者解决对比失真。
- 出错时只影响同时用到这个周占位符和对比功能的图表,对比数值不对;可直接撤回本改动。
- 无

## What changes
`shiftFilterByCompareTo` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/compare-to.ts`) renamed date macros but left the `{current_iso_week}` period key as written, so the server resolved it to the current week and the comparison series filtered the same week as the main one.
- `previousPeriod`: `{current_iso_week}` / `${current_iso_week}` is replaced by the literal previous ISO week key (`2026-W22` becomes `2026-W21`). Week 1 steps back to the previous ISO year's last week: W53 when that year starts on a Thursday (or a Wednesday in a leap year), else W52. The literal key passes through every resolver unchanged. No new public token is added.
- `previousYear`: the period key is resolved against the same shifted day the date macros already use (`resolvePeriodKeyTokens`), so it is the ISO week of the same day one year earlier.
- `compareToTrendLabelKey`: a filter on `{current_iso_week}` now reads `vsLastWeek` instead of falling through to `vsPreviousPeriod`.

Other period-key placeholders that share the gap: none. `PERIOD_KEY_TOKENS` in `@objectstack/spec/data` has one member, `current_iso_week`.

## Tests
New block `compare-to on the {current_iso_week} period key` in `ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/compare-to.test.ts`: previousPeriod mid-year (W22 to W21, both spellings), week 1 to 2026-W53 and to 2025-W52, previousYear (2025-W21; Fri 2027-01-01 = 2026-W53 becomes 2026-W01), and the label.

<details><summary>Run on a2b9aa62</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/ --maxWorkers=1` (from `ui/`, under the verify lock): Test Files 124 passed (124), Tests 2214 passed (2214). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check`: exit 0. Lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablation, one-off (fix committed first): deleted the `current_iso_week` substitution line with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `grep -c` of the anchor = 0 on disk. compare-to.test.ts: Tests 2 failed / 33 passed. Both previousPeriod pins went red, and the received value was `'{current_iso_week}'`, which is the bug. The test imports the source by relative path, so there is no dist leg. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`: `git diff HEAD` is empty and the blob hash matches HEAD (`d276c311`).
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- ADR-0021 D3 dataset path: `service-analytics` `dataset-executor.ts` shifts only the chosen time dimension's `dateRange` (`shiftRange`). A selection `filter` is held constant across the compare pass, whether it holds a date macro or a period key. That is the executor's existing design, not a period-key regression. Noted here, not filed: read from code, no public-door measurement.

## Verification
Read first: `compare-to.ts` `previousIsoWeekKey` (the year-edge arithmetic is the risky hunk), then its call in `shiftFilterByCompareTo`.
Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/compare-to.test.ts`. Expect 35 passed.
